1	# Epic 1 Context: Foundation & Session Management
2	
3	<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->
4	
5	## Goal
6	
7	This epic delivers the scaffold every other feature depends on: the pinned-stack project setup with its core infrastructure verified working together, the full visual design-token system, email/password authentication with silent session refresh, the session-expiry recovery overlay, and a base navigation shell with placeholders for everything not yet built. It is delivered first because every later epic assumes this foundation — DI, networking, error handling, session state, design tokens, and navigation — already exists and is stable. Users come away able to create an account, log in, stay logged in across restarts, recover gracefully if their session expires mid-use, and navigate the whole app shell even though most feature screens are still placeholders.
8	
9	## Stories
10	
11	- Story 1.1: Project Scaffold, Stack Integration & Core Infrastructure
12	- Story 1.2: Design Token System & Core Component Library
13	- Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login
14	- Story 1.4: Silent Session Refresh & Persistence
15	- Story 1.5: Expired-Session Recovery Overlay
16	- Story 1.6: Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders
17	
18	## Requirements & Constraints
19	
20	- Account creation and login round-trip through the backend with exactly two fields (email, password) — no password confirmation, no display-name field at signup. Login/signup/refresh are the only calls using the anon key; every other call uses the user's access token.
21	- A valid, unexpired session must persist across app restarts with no re-prompt; nearing/past-expiry sessions refresh silently with no visible loading UI unless the call exceeds 300ms.
22	- When the backend reports an expired session, an overlay appears over whatever screen is active (never a navigation away); the underlying screen's state/scroll position is preserved; "Entrar novamente" leads to biometric/PIN re-auth, not a login form.
23	- All four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) must be reachable from launch; any destination whose feature isn't built yet shows a visually distinct, fully-polished placeholder — never a broken link and never a visibly "unfinished" look.
24	- Local UI interactions must respond in <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator (manual timing spot-check, no automated perf tooling).
25	- Zero Clean Architecture layer violations: domain imports neither Flutter nor anything from a data layer.
26	- ≥80% domain-layer test coverage; the write-failure matrix (5 write endpoints × 3 failure types: timeout, malformed response, no connection = 15 scenarios) must be fully handled with zero unhandled exceptions — this epic builds the one shared, reusable test helper every later feature's write-endpoint tests reuse.
27	- Zero hardcoded visual values outside the design-tokens file; every control must honor Dynamic Type without truncating.
28	- An integration spike, before any other building, must prove `dio` + `flutter_secure_storage` + `get_it` work together in one bootstrap — this combination is otherwise unverified.
29	
30	## Technical Decisions
31	
32	- Single DI container: exactly one `get_it` instance registered at bootstrap; `dio` is configured through it; secrets (`FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`) load via `flutter_dotenv` from a gitignored `.env`, never hardcoded.
33	- One sealed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes (13 from the backend's error taxonomy plus a local-only `MalformedResponse`), defined once and never redefined/subset per feature; every repository method returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (or a `Stream` for SSE), with no native/dio exception ever escaping unmapped.
34	- One retry interceptor on the `dio`/`ApiClient` layer retries only the 6 server-marked `retryable:true` codes; every other failure surfaces once, unretried.
35	- One URL builder maps every operation to `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<x-cerne-function>/<path-params>` (never the literal OpenAPI REST path); one interceptor owns headers — `apikey` on every call, anon-key bearer token only on signup/login/refresh, user access token on everything else.
36	- Exactly one `SessionStatus` stream is exposed from the auth feature's domain layer and registered once in DI as a singleton; every later consumer (including RF07/Epic 4) injects/listens to it rather than re-deriving session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream.
37	- This epic builds the `go_router` redirect skeleton composing session state; Epic 2 (RF03) later plugs a local vault-status gate into the same redirect, checked before session status — this epic should leave that composition point open rather than hardcoding a session-only redirect.
38	- Strict layer direction applies project-wide: only `data/` imports `dio`/`hive_ce`/platform plugins; `presentation/` never imports any feature's `data/` directly; a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as a dependency.
39	- Structural seed to scaffold: `lib/core/{design_tokens.dart, network/, failure/, di/, cache/, resource.dart, isolated_side_effect.dart, session/}` and `lib/features/{auth, vault, entries, capture, chat, export, dashboard, account}/`, each pre-wired for `data/domain/presentation`.
40	- Full stack is pinned (Flutter 3.47.x via `fvm`; `flutter_bloc`, `go_router`, `dio`, `hive_ce`, `get_it`, `fpdart`, `freezed`, `json_serializable`, `mocktail`, `fl_chart`, `local_auth`, `flutter_secure_storage`, `flutter_dotenv`, `whisper_ggml` — exact versions in the architecture spine's stack-pins table) and must resolve with no conflicts before anything else is built.
41	- Design tokens (`colors`, `typography`, `rounded`, `spacing`, `components`, plus the two elevation constants) are implemented verbatim, camelCase, as the single source of truth; every other file reads from them, never redefines a value.
42	
43	## UX & Interaction Patterns
44	
45	- Single fixed frame: 390×844 logical points, portrait only, light mode only — no breakpoint, landscape, or dark-mode path anywhere in the app.
46	- Buttons and text fields come from one shared component set: disabled buttons always render `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary` text (never dimmed opacity); text fields show distinct default/focused(`colorPrimary`, 1.5px)/error(`colorError`) border states.
47	- The side menu is the sole navigation hub (plus back arrows and sheet "x" closes) — no drawer-within-drawer, no tab bar. It must resolve all four destinations (chat session switching, Meus Registros, Configurações, Planos de Ação) without a 404 or crash.
48	- The Planos de Ação placeholder (an explicit, never-implemented extension feature) must still look fully finished — same visual polish as real screens, no graying-out, no backend calls, no drag/drop logic.
49	- The avatar component (solid `colorPrimary` circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, 40px) is built here for reuse, not reimplementation, when Configurações needs its 52px variant later (Epic 8).
50	- The "Sessão expirada" overlay is a scrim over the current screen using the confirmation-dialog component with a neutral (`colorTextPrimary`) title — never the red destructive-title variant. It traps focus until dismissed/actioned, is the only overlay allowed on screen at a time (never stacks on another open overlay), and its entrance uses only the `scrimIn` (0.18s) choreography — no other motion exists in the system besides `sheetUp` for bottom sheets.
51	- Copy for the overlay must avoid any language implying data loss or starting over; history and scroll position are understood by the user to be preserved.
52	
53	## Cross-Story Dependencies
54	
55	- Story 1.1 (DI, API client, Failure hierarchy, URL builder, retry interceptor, shared failure-matrix test helper) is a hard prerequisite for every other story in this epic and for every later epic's write-endpoint tests.
56	- Story 1.2's design tokens and base components (buttons, text fields, avatar) are consumed by Story 1.3's login/signup screen, Story 1.5's overlay, and Story 1.6's navigation shell/placeholders.
57	- Story 1.4 depends on Story 1.3's auth calls and exposes the singleton `SessionStatus` stream that Story 1.5 listens to and that the `go_router` redirect skeleton composes.
58	- Story 1.5's "Entrar novamente" action routes to the biometric/PIN re-auth flow that is not built until Epic 2 — this epic should wire the route target without implementing that flow.
59	- Story 1.6's `go_router` redirect skeleton is extended by Epic 2 (RF03), which plugs in the local vault-status gate ahead of the session gate already built here, in a fixed order (vault checked first).
60	- Story 1.6's avatar component and placeholder-styling pattern are reused as-is by Epic 8 (Configurações' 52px avatar, other placeholder surfaces).
61

1	# Cerne — Prototype extract
2	
3	The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.
4	
5	- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
6	- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
7	- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 1. Navigation map
12	
13	The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).
14	
15	```
16	Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
17	  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
18	  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
19	  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
20	  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
21	  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat
22	
23	Home/Chat (base screen)
24	  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
25	  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
26	  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
27	        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)
28	
29	Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
30	  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
31	  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
32	  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period
33	
34	Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)
35	
36	Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
37	  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
38	  ├─ inline profile-name editing
39	  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
40	  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
41	  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
42	```
43	
44	---
45	
46	## 2. Navigable states
47	
48	Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). 183	## 4. Special states that need extra care
184	
185	- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
186	- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
187	- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
188	- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
189	- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
190	- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.
191	
192	---
193	
194	## 5. Implementation notes
195	
196	1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
197	2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
198	3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
199	4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
200	5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
201	6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
202	7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

6	/// The epic's ONE new DI-singleton access point for session validity (AD) —
7	/// every later consumer (Story 1.5's overlay, Story 1.6's `go_router`
8	/// redirect, Epic 4/RF07) listens to [statusStream] rather than re-deriving
9	/// session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream (RNF09 — still
10	/// `Either<Failure, T>` for the one-shot [restoreSession] call).
11	abstract class SessionRepository {
12	  /// Broadcast stream of the current session status. Emits nothing until
13	  /// [restoreSession] (or a later story's own trigger) completes at least
14	  /// once — a `StreamBuilder` with no data yet is the brief-blank boot state
15	  /// `main.dart` relies on (RNF01's 300ms threshold).
16	  Stream<SessionStatus> get statusStream;
17	
18	  /// Boot-time, unconditional refresh: exchanges any stored refresh token
19	  /// for a fresh pair via `auth-refresh`, persists the result, and emits the
20	  /// outcome on [statusStream]. No client-side expiry math — the server is
21	  /// the sole source of truth for validity.
22	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> restoreSession();
23	
24	  /// Releases the underlying stream resource. Wired as `get_it`'s
25	  /// `dispose:` callback on registration, so `resetCoreDependencies()`
26	  /// (`sl.reset()`) closes it instead of leaking a `StreamController` on
27	  /// every test teardown.
28	  Future<void> dispose();
29	}

9	/// Drives Tela 0.1a. Calls [AuthRepository] directly (no use-case — Code Map:
10	/// this story's scope is small enough that an extra indirection layer isn't
11	/// justified yet); a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as
12	/// a dependency (architecture spine), so this takes the repository port.
13	class AuthCubit extends Cubit<AuthState> {
14	  AuthCubit(this._authRepository) : super(const AuthState());
15	
16	  final AuthRepository _authRepository;
17	
18	  /// Toggles login/signup — same screen, not a navigation (epics.md Story
19	  /// 1.3 AC). Keeps whatever the user already typed; clears any error from
20	  /// the previous mode's attempt. Goes through `copyWith` (rather than a raw
21	  /// `AuthState(...)`) so an in-flight `status` is never silently reset to
22	  /// idle by this call.
23	  void toggleMode() {
24	    emit(
25	      state.copyWith(
26	        mode: state.mode == AuthMode.login ? AuthMode.signUp : AuthMode.login,
27	        clearEmailError: true,
28	        clearPasswordError: true,
29	        clearFormError: true,
30	      ),
31	    );
32	  }
33	
34	  void emailChanged(String value) {
35	    emit(
36	      state.copyWith(
37	        email: value,
38	        clearEmailError: true,
39	        clearPasswordError: true,
40	        clearFormError: true,
41	      ),
42	    );
43	  }
44	
45	  void passwordChanged(String value) {
46	    emit(
47	      state.copyWith(
48	        password: value,
49	        clearEmailError: true,
50	        clearPasswordError: true,
51	        clearFormError: true,
52	      ),
53	    );
54	  }
55	
56	  /// Validates locally first — a malformed email (or empty password) blocks
57	  /// submit *before* any round trip (epics.md Story 1.3 AC), each as its own
58	  /// single-field error so only the offending field is ever bordered. Only
59	  /// once local validation passes does it call `auth-signup`/`auth-login`
60	  /// with exactly `{email, password}` (the e-mail trimmed — stray
61	  /// leading/trailing whitespace must never reach the backend and risk a
62	  /// spurious `AUTH_INVALID`), saving the access token (via the repository)
63	  /// before this resolves.
64	  Future<void> submit() async {
65	    if (state.isSubmitting) {
66	      return;
67	    }
68	
69	    final emailError = validateEmail(state.email);
70	    if (emailError != null) {
71	      emit(
72	        state.copyWith(
73	          emailError: emailError,
74	          clearPasswordError: true,
75	          clearFormError: true,
76	        ),
77	      );
78	      return;
79	    }
80	
81	    final passwordError = validatePassword(state.password);
82	    if (passwordError != null) {
83	      emit(
84	        state.copyWith(
85	          passwordError: passwordError,
86	          clearEmailError: true,
87	          clearFormError: true,
88	        ),
89	      );
90	      return;
91	    }
92	
93	    emit(
94	      state.copyWith(
95	        status: const ResourceLoading<Unit>(),
96	        clearEmailError: true,
97	        clearPasswordError: true,
98	        clearFormError: true,
99	      ),
100	    );
101	
102	    final trimmedEmail = state.email.trim();
103	    final result = state.mode == AuthMode.login
104	        ? await _authRepository.logIn(
105	            email: trimmedEmail,
106	            password: state.password,
107	          )
108	        : await _authRepository.signUp(
109	            email: trimmedEmail,
110	            password: state.password,
111	          );
112	
113	    result.match(
114	      (failure) => emit(
115	        state.copyWith(
116	          status: const ResourceIdle<Unit>(),
117	          formError: failure.message,
118	        ),
119	      ),
120	      // Clears the typed password once it's done its job — the access
121	      // token is already persisted by now, so there's no reason for the
122	      // plaintext value to keep sitting in this (DI-singleton, long-lived)
123	      // cubit's state after success.
124	      (_) => emit(
125	        state.copyWith(status: const ResourceData<Unit>(unit), password: ''),
126	      ),
127	    );
128	  }
129	}

6	/// Shared confirmation-dialog overlay (prototype-extract.md §6: "scrim +
7	/// centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive
8	/// deletion)"). Story 1.5 is the first consumer (neutral `colorTextPrimary`
9	/// title, the session-expiry recovery copy); a later story (Epic 8's
10	/// account-deletion confirm) reuses this same widget with [titleColor]
11	/// set to `DesignTokens.colorError` and a heavier [barrierColor].
12	///
13	/// UX-DR16/25/27/36: non-dismissible barrier, focus trapped on the dialog,
14	/// `scrimIn` (0.18s ease-out fade) as the only entrance choreography, and
15	/// at most one instance open at a time — [show] is the one way this
16	/// widget is ever presented, and owns that single-overlay guard itself so
17	/// no caller has to re-implement it.
18	class ConfirmationDialog extends StatelessWidget {
19	  const ConfirmationDialog({
20	    super.key,
21	    required this.icon,
22	    required this.title,
23	    required this.message,
24	    required this.confirmLabel,
25	    required this.onConfirm,
26	    required this.barrierColor,
27	    this.titleColor = DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
28	    this.caption,
29	  });
30	
31	  final IconData icon;
32	  final String title;
33	  final String message;
34	  final String confirmLabel;
35	  final VoidCallback onConfirm;
36	
37	  /// The full-bleed scrim color behind the centered card — callers pass
38	  /// `DesignTokens.colorScrim` (session-expiry, Story 1.5) or the heavier
39	  /// drawer/sheet value a later story uses for its own confirmation.
40	  final Color barrierColor;
41	
42	  /// Neutral (`colorTextPrimary`, the default — Story 1.5's session copy)
43	  /// or destructive (`colorError`, a later story's account-deletion
44	  /// confirm) — never any other color (Boundaries: "neutral
45	  /// `colorTextPrimary` title, never `colorError`" for *this* story's own
46	  /// call site).
47	  final Color titleColor;
48	
49	  /// Small mono caption below the button (Story 1.5: "o histórico e a
50	  /// posição do scroll são preservados"). Optional — a future destructive
51	  /// confirmation has no equivalent.
52	  final String? caption;
53	
54	  /// Whether an instance is currently showing — the single-overlay guard
55	  /// (UX-DR16/25/27/36: "never stacks on another open overlay"). Exposed
56	  /// for tests; callers should not need to read it directly.
57	  static bool isOpen = false;
58	
59	  /// Presents [builder]'s [ConfirmationDialog] as a non-dismissible,
60	  /// focus-trapped overlay above whatever screen is currently showing,
61	  /// without replacing it — the underlying route stays mounted, so its
62	  /// scroll/state is preserved (Boundaries: "the authenticated screen's
63	  /// widget instance is never replaced").
64	  ///
65	  /// A second call while one is already open is a silent no-op (I/O
66	  /// matrix: "already-open overlay ... no second dialog stacks").
67	  static Future<void> show({
68	    required BuildContext context,
69	    required WidgetBuilder builder,
70	  }) {
71	    if (isOpen) {
72	      return Future<void>.value();
73	    }
74	    isOpen = true;
75	    try {
76	      return showGeneralDialog<void>(
77	        context: context,
78	        barrierDismissible: false,
79	        // The framework's own `ModalBarrier` stays fully transparent — the
80	        // scrim actually seen on screen is this widget's own `build()`
81	        // below, which lets `transitionBuilder` fade the scrim and the card
82	        // together as one `scrimIn` choreography instead of two separately
83	        // animated layers.
84	        barrierColor: Colors.transparent,
85	        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
86	        transitionBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
87	          return FadeTransition(
88	            opacity: CurvedAnimation(
89	              parent: animation,
90	              curve: Curves.easeOut,
91	            ),
92	            child: child,
93	          );
94	        },
95	        pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) => PopScope(
96	          // UX-DR16/25/27/36 — non-dismissible: `barrierDismissible: false`
97	          // above only stops a scrim tap; without this, the system/hardware
98	          // back gesture would still pop the route and close the overlay.
99	          canPop: false,
100	          child: builder(context),
101	        ),
102	      ).whenComplete(() => isOpen = false);
103	    } catch (_) {
104	      // A synchronous throw from `showGeneralDialog` (e.g. a future caller
105	      // passing a `context` with no `Navigator` ancestor) must still release
106	      // the guard — otherwise every later `show()` call, from any caller,
107	      // silently no-ops forever.
108	      isOpen = false;
109	      rethrow;
110	    }
111	  }
112	
113	  @override
114	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
115	    return Stack(
116	      fit: StackFit.expand,
117	      children: [
118	        ColoredBox(color: barrierColor),
119	        // `LayoutBuilder` + `ConstrainedBox(minHeight: ...)` is the
120	        // standard "centered, but scrollable if it doesn't fit" shape:
121	        // ordinary-scale content still centers vertically exactly as
122	        // before (the min-height constraint is satisfied with room to
123	        // spare, so `Center` centers within it), but under an extreme
124	        // Dynamic Type scale — where the card's intrinsic height can
125	        // exceed the screen — this scrolls instead of overflowing
126	        // (RNF08's "no control truncates under Dynamic Type").
127	        LayoutBuilder(
128	          builder: (context, constraints) => SingleChildScrollView(
129	            child: ConstrainedBox(
130	              constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: constraints.maxHeight),
131	              child: Center(
132	                child: Padding(
133	                  padding: DesignTokens.dialogScreenMargin,
134	                  child: _Card(
135	                    icon: icon,
136	                    title: title,
137	                    titleColor: titleColor,
138	                    message: message,
139	                    confirmLabel: confirmLabel,
140	                    onConfirm: onConfirm,
141	                    caption: caption,
142	                  ),
143	                ),
144	              ),
145	            ),
146	          ),
147	        ),
148	      ],
149	    );
150	  }
151	}
152	
153	class _Card extends StatelessWidget {
154	  const _Card({
155	    required this.icon,
156	    required this.title,
157	    required this.titleColor,
158	    required this.message,
159	    required this.confirmLabel,
160	    required this.onConfirm,
161	    required this.caption,
162	  });
163	
164	  final IconData icon;
165	  final String title;
166	  final Color titleColor;
167	  final String message;
168	  final String confirmLabel;
169	  final VoidCallback onConfirm;
170	  final String? caption;
171	
172	  @override
173	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
174	    return Container(

176	      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
177	        color: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
178	        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusLg)),
179	        boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation2,
180	      ),
181	      child: Column(
182	        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
183	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
184	        children: [
185	          Row(
186	            children: [
187	              Icon(
188	                icon,
189	                size: DesignTokens.dialogIconSize,
190	                color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
191	              ),
192	              const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
193	              Expanded(
194	                child: Text(
195	                  title,
196	                  style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm.copyWith(color: titleColor),
197	                ),
198	              ),
199	            ],
200	          ),
201	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dialogContentGap),
202	          Text(
203	            message,
204	            style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
205	              color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
206	            ),
207	          ),
208	          const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dialogContentGap),
209	          AppButton(label: confirmLabel, onPressed: onConfirm),
210	          if (caption != null) ...[
211	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dialogContentGap),
212	            Text(

Building that (new `AccessTokenProvider.saveUserEmail`/`readUserEmail`, a `SessionRepository.currentUserEmail` accessor, and `AuthRepositoryImpl` wiring) pushed this story's spec well past its token budget (≈2.5k vs. the 900-1600 target) alongside the go_router shell itself, which is the story's actual goal. Carved off rather than folded in; revisit once Epic 8's `displayName` exists, or sooner if a real identity in the drawer is wanted before then — the generic header is still fully polished (not grayed-out/broken), satisfying this story's own acceptance bar.

10	/// in-flight submit status.
11	///
12	/// [emailError] and [passwordError] are each single-field, pre-network local
13	/// validation errors — set independently, one per field, never together
14	/// (`AuthCubit.submit` checks email first and returns before ever touching
15	/// password validation). [formError] is reserved for an actual backend-call
16	/// failure (`AUTH_INVALID`/network/any other `Failure`) — it never overlaps
17	/// with either local error, since `submit` only reaches the network call
18	/// once both local checks already passed.
19	class AuthState {
20	  const AuthState({
21	    this.mode = AuthMode.login,
22	    this.email = '',
23	    this.password = '',
24	    this.emailError,

37

39	  /// senha field only — unlike [formError], this never borders the e-mail
40	  /// field too (the e-mail value already passed its own check).
41	  final String? passwordError;
42	
43	  /// `AUTH_INVALID`/`Failure.message` from the backend call. Shown once,
44	  /// under the senha field, while *both* fields get the error border (the
45	  /// e-mail field via `errorText: ''`, border-only).
46	  final String? formError;
47

49

51

## Intent

**Problem:** `ApiClient._mapDioException` already maps any mid-session `AUTH_EXPIRED` response to `Failure.authExpired` (`api_client.dart:95-111`), but nothing reacts to it — `SessionStatus` only ever emits from the boot-time `restoreSession()` call (`session_repository_impl.dart:81-136`), so an expired session mid-use today surfaces only as a raw inline error on whatever screen made the call, and the user is never routed back to re-auth.

**Approach:** Add a core `SessionExpiryNotifier` port (in the already-scaffolded empty `lib/core/session/`) that `ApiClient` signals on any non-boot `AUTH_EXPIRED`; `SessionRepositoryImpl` bridges that into one new `SessionStatus.expired` value on the epic's existing single stream. `main.dart` keeps rendering the same authenticated screen across that transition and shows a new shared `ConfirmationDialog` overlay (neutral title) whose "Entrar novamente" button routes to a throwaway re-auth placeholder standing in for Epic 2's biometric/PIN flow.

Implemented spec-1-6-base-navigation-shell-with-feature-placeholders.md in full. All Execution/Acceptance checkboxes in the spec file are now marked `[x]` and its frontmatter `status` set to `'done'`.

## What changed

**Session/auth plumbing (sync redirect after login):**
- `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart` — added `SessionStatus? get currentStatus` and `void markAuthenticated()`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart` — `currentStatus` returns `_lastStatus`; `markAuthenticated()` calls `_emit(SessionStatus.authenticated)` directly (no network/storage).
- `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart` — new `SessionRepository` constructor dep; `submit()`'s success branch calls `markAuthenticated()` before emitting `ResourceData`.
- `lib/features/auth/auth_injection.dart` — wires `sl<SessionRepository>()` into `AuthCubit`.

**Navigation shell (new):**
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — the one `GoRouter`; `AppRoutePaths` constants for all 7 routes; `redirect` composes only `SessionStatus` with an explicit AD-14 comment seam for Epic 2's `VaultStatus`; a private `_GoRouterRefreshStream` (ChangeNotifier wrapping `statusStream`) since go_router 18.1.1 has no built-in one.
- `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart` — `MaterialApp.router`'s `builder:`; same Story 1.5 one-shot overlay guard, now navigates via a held `GoRouter` reference (`router.go('/reauth')`) rather than `context.go` — necessary because `WidgetsApp.builder`'s own context sits *above* the Router/`InheritedGoRouter`, so `context.go`/`Navigator.of(context)` can't be used there. The dialog itself is shown via `navigatorKey.currentState.overlay.context`, which *is* below the Navigator.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart` — native `Drawer` (not a hand-rolled overlay), generic `Avatar('U')` + static "Usuário" label, no `CONVERSAS` section, "Novo Chat" (closes drawer, no-op) + 3 nav items via `context.go`.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — `BootSplashScreen`, `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` (dark-green header, ☰ opens drawer), `BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen`, `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen`/`ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (shared back-arrow header + polished placeholder body), `ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen` (static 3-column kanban with the prototype's exact hardcoded cards, zero backend calls).
- `lib/main.dart` — rewritten to `MaterialApp.router`; `_CerneAppState` builds the router once, still fires `restoreSession()` at boot, disposes the router.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — added `colorScrimHeavy`, `drawerWidth`, nav/drawer/kanban size+gap tokens, and the composite `EdgeInsets` constants (`navHeaderPadding`, `drawerContentPadding`, `drawerHeaderPadding`, `drawerNavItemPadding`, `drawerPrimaryActionPadding`, `kanbanBoardPadding`, `kanbanCardPadding`) — all derived from the existing spacing scale where possible.
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` — portrait-only orientation lock (both `UISupportedInterfaceOrientations` keys).

**Tests:** extended `session_repository_impl_test.dart` and `auth_cubit_test.dart` (+ `auth_screen_test.dart` for the new constructor param); new `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` (full redirect matrix), `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart`, `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart`; `test/main_test.dart` rewritten around the go_router shell (introduces a small `_FakeSessionRepository` since the overlay/router tests need `currentStatus` to update synchronously, not just a stubbed stream); `design_tokens_test.dart` extended for every new token.

## Verification
- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolves, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — all 262 tests pass.
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/core/navigation lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart lib/main.dart` — no matches (RNF08 literal check from the spec's own Verification section).
- `dart format` run over all touched files; re-ran analyze/test afterward — still clean.

## Notable implementation decision worth flagging
`MaterialApp.router`'s `builder:` widget is documented by Flutter as being inserted *above* the Router/`Navigator`, not below it. The frozen spec's Code Map said `ExpiryOverlayHost` should do `context.go('/reauth')` on confirm, but that literally cannot resolve `InheritedGoRouter` from that position. I kept the one-shot overlay behavior and the end result (routes to `/reauth`) identical, but implemented it by holding the `GoRouter` instance directly (`router.go(...)`) and sourcing the dialog's `BuildContext` from `navigatorKey.currentState.overlay.context` instead of the widget's own context. This is documented inline in `expiry_overlay_host.dart`.

## Incomplete / risky
Nothing left incomplete against the spec's boundaries. Minor judgment calls made where the prototype's exact pixel values didn't map onto an existing typography token (e.g. kanban column titles use `textLabelMd` rather than a new Karla-700-13px token, since the spec didn't license a new typography token and the existing scale has no exact match) — these stay within the design-token system, just with a slight weight/size approximation versus the prototype's raw CSS. No new extension-feature logic was added to Planos de Ação (still fully static).

The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Review of your Story 1.6 implementation is done (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap layers, run in parallel against the diff). Five findings were classified as `patch` — trivially fixable, no spec/intent change needed. Apply all five, then re-run the spec's own Verification commands (`fvm flutter pub get`, `fvm flutter analyze`, `fvm flutter test`, and the RNF08 grep) and confirm they still pass.

1. **`lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart`** — `AppDrawer` wraps its content in `SafeArea` *and* applies `DesignTokens.drawerContentPadding`'s hardcoded top value of 59 on top of it, double-counting the status-bar clearance. Every other header in this story (`HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`, `_BackArrowHeader` in `placeholder_screens.dart`) uses the fixed-59 `navHeaderPadding` with no `SafeArea` at all — consistent with the epic's fixed 390×844 single-frame design (no responsive/dynamic-inset handling anywhere else in the app). Fix: remove the `SafeArea` wrapper from `AppDrawer`, so it relies on `drawerContentPadding`'s fixed top value alone, matching the other headers' convention.

2. **`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` + `expiry_overlay_host.dart` + `lib/main.dart`** — `ExpiryOverlayHost` currently finds a `BuildContext` below the `Navigator` via `widget.router.routerDelegate.navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context`, reaching into `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` — not a documented public API, so a future go_router upgrade could silently break it. `GoRouter` itself has no public `navigatorKey` getter (confirmed against the pinned 18.1.1 source), but it does accept an explicit `navigatorKey` constructor parameter. Fix: in `main.dart` (or inside `buildAppRouter`), create your own `final navigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();`, pass it to `GoRouter(navigatorKey: navigatorKey, ...)`, and pass that *same* key into `ExpiryOverlayHost` as a new constructor parameter, using `navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context` there instead of drilling through `routerDelegate`.

3. **Test coverage** — `ExpiryOverlayHost._onStatus`'s `overlayContext == null` branch ("Navigator not mounted yet") has no test. Add one — e.g. trigger the `expired` status before the router's `Navigator` is mounted/pumped, and assert no exception and `_expiryOverlayShown` resets to `false` (so a later mount can still show it). Bundle this with fix #2 since it touches the same code path.

4. **`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart`** — `_GoRouterRefreshStream`'s `stream.listen((_) => notifyListeners())` has no `onError` guard, unlike its sibling listeners added in this same diff (`ExpiryOverlayHost`'s `statusStream.listen(_onStatus, onError: (_, _) {})` and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s `_expirySubscription`). Fix: add `onError: (_, _) {}` for consistency — no current stream implementation errors, but a future one that did shouldn't surface as an unhandled zone exception here specifically.

5. **`test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart`** — the existing "☰ opens AppDrawer" test on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` only asserts `find.text('Cerne')` and `find.byType(AppDrawer)`; nothing asserts `Scaffold.drawerScrimColor` actually equals `DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy` (only the token's raw RGBA value is tested elsewhere, never that it's wired to the `Scaffold`). Fix: extend that test to pull the `Scaffold` widget (`tester.widget<Scaffold>(find.byType(Scaffold).first)`) and assert `.drawerScrimColor == DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy`.

input.message:
Applied all five patch-classified review findings.

1. **`lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart`** — removed the `SafeArea` wrapper; `AppDrawer` now relies solely on `drawerContentPadding`'s fixed top value (59), matching `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`/`_BackArrowHeader`'s convention.

2. **Public-API navigatorKey threading** — `buildAppRouter` (`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart`) now takes a required `navigatorKey: GlobalKey<NavigatorState>` and passes it straight to `GoRouter(navigatorKey: ...)`. `ExpiryOverlayHost` (`lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart`) now takes that same `navigatorKey` as a constructor param and reads `widget.navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context` instead of drilling through `widget.router.routerDelegate.navigatorKey`. `lib/main.dart`'s `_CerneAppState` creates one `GlobalKey<NavigatorState>` and passes the identical instance to both `buildAppRouter` and `ExpiryOverlayHost`. Updated the one other call site, `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart`'s `pumpRouter` helper, to pass a key too.

3. **New test** — `test/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host_test.dart`: first pumps `ExpiryOverlayHost` with a `navigatorKey` that matches no mounted `Navigator`, triggers `expired`, and asserts no exception + no dialog (the `overlayContext == null` branch). Then, without remounting the widget (same `State` instance, via a second `pumpWidget` of the same type/position but now with a real `Navigator(key: navigatorKey, ...)` as `child`), re-emits `expired` and asserts the dialog *does* show this time — proving `_expiryOverlayShown` was actually reset to `false` on the first failed attempt, not left stuck.

4. **`lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart`** — `_GoRouterRefreshStream`'s `stream.listen(...)` now passes `onError: (_, _) {}`, matching the sibling subscriptions in `ExpiryOverlayHost` and `SessionRepositoryImpl`.

5. **`test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart`** — extended the existing `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` test to pull the `Scaffold` widget and assert `scaffold.drawerScrimColor == DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy`, so the token is proven wired, not just correct in isolation.

## Verification (spec's own commands, re-run after all five fixes)
- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolves, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — all 263 tests pass (262 before + 1 new test in `expiry_overlay_host_test.dart`; the drawer-scrim assertion was added to an existing test, not a new one).
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/core/navigation lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart lib/main.dart` — no matches.

Also ran `dart format` over every touched file after the fixes and re-verified analyze/test stayed green (whitespace-only diffs).

Nothing else changed; the other review findings (accessibility/error-builder/test-coverage) were triaged by the coordinator as deferred and are out of scope for this patch round.
